hook.en: A company buys a ₹4.4 lakh machine but pays no cash: the seller accepts debentures instead. A bank loan can also be backed by debentures as extra *security*.

title.en: Issue for consideration other than cash

body.en: When assets are bought from a vendor: (1) Sundry Assets A/c Dr (and Goodwill if consideration exceeds net assets), To Sundry Liabilities A/c, To Vendor A/c (Capital Reserve if less). (2) Vendor A/c Dr, To X% Debentures A/c, To Securities Premium A/c. Number of debentures = Amount payable ÷ *Issue* price.
body.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿ ಖರೀದಿಗಾಗಿ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನಿಗೆ ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ನೀಡಿದಾಗ, ಮೊದಲು ಆಸ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು, ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ನಂತರ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು, ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = ಪಾವತಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಮೊತ್ತ ÷ ವಿತರಣಾ ಬೆಲೆ.

narration.en: When debentures are given to a vendor for assets, first debit the assets and credit the vendor. Then debit the vendor and credit debentures. The number of debentures is the amount payable divided by the issue price.
narration.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿ ಖರೀದಿಗಾಗಿ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನಿಗೆ ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ನೀಡಿದಾಗ, ಮೊದಲು ಆಸ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು, ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ನಂತರ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು, ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = ಪಾವತಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಮೊತ್ತ ÷ ವಿತರಣಾ ಬೆಲೆ.

blocks.formula: \text{Number of debentures} = \frac{\text{Purchase consideration}}{\text{Issue price per debenture}}

say.en: When debentures are given to a vendor for assets, first debit the assets and credit the vendor. Then debit the vendor and credit debentures. The number of debentures is the amount payable divided by the issue price. Goodwill equals consideration - net assets if positive.
say.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿ ಖರೀದಿಗಾಗಿ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನಿಗೆ ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ನೀಡಿದಾಗ, ಮೊದಲು ಆಸ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು, ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ನಂತರ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು, ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = ಪಾವತಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಮೊತ್ತ divided by ವಿತರಣಾ ಬೆಲೆ.

say.en: Capital Reserve equals net assets - consideration if positive.

caption.en: A company takes over assets and liabilities and pays the vendor in ₹100 debentures. If it pays more than the net assets, the excess is goodwill; if less, the difference is capital reserve.

say.en: Debentures to a vendor A company takes over assets and liabilities and pays the vendor in 100 rupees debentures. If it pays more than the net assets, the excess is goodwill; if less, the difference is capital reserve.

body.en: *Collateral security* is a secondary security given in addition to the primary security for a loan. First method: no entry; a note under the loan states it is secured by debentures. Second method: Debenture Suspense A/c Dr, To X% Debentures A/c; the suspense is deducted from debentures in the note on Long-term borrowings. No interest is paid on collateral debentures.
body.kn: ಮೇಲಾಧಾರ ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳು ಸಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಭದ್ರತೆ. ನಮೂದು ಮಾಡದೆ ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿ ನೀಡಬಹುದು, ಅಥವಾ ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ತೂಗು ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಹಾಕಿ ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಇವುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಕೊಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Method 2: Debenture Suspense A/c Dr, To *Debentures* A/c
On repayment of loan the entry is reversed

problem.en: Ram Ltd. bought machinery for ₹4,40,000 from Kiran Traders and paid by issuing 10% debentures of ₹100 each at a premium of 10%. Pass entries.

steps.en: Machinery A/c Dr ₹4,40,000; To Kiran Traders ₹4,40,000.
Kiran Traders Dr ₹4,40,000; To 10% Debentures A/c ₹4,00,000; To Securities Premium A/c ₹40,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Ram Ltd. bought machinery for 4,40,000 rupees from Kiran Traders and paid by issuing 10 percent debentures of 100 rupees each at a premium of 10 percent. Pass entries.
Number of debentures equals 4,40,000 rupees divided by 110 rupees equals 4,000.
Machinery A over c Dr 4,40,000 rupees; To Kiran Traders 4,40,000 rupees.
Kiran Traders Dr 4,40,000 rupees; To 10 percent Debentures A over c 4,00,000 rupees; To Securities Premium A over c 40,000 rupees.
So the answer is 4,000 debentures; Debentures 4,00,000 rupees and Securities Premium 40,000 rupees.

problem.en: Sharavathi Ltd. took a bank loan of ₹5,00,000 and issued 6,000, 9% debentures of ₹100 each as collateral security. Record by the second method.

steps.en: Debenture Suspense A/c Dr ₹6,00,000; To 9% Debentures A/c ₹6,00,000.
Note on Long-term borrowings: Bank loan ₹5,00,000; 9% Debentures ₹6,00,000 less Debenture Suspense ₹6,00,000 = nil.

answer.en: Net effect on borrowings is only the loan of ₹5,00,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Sharavathi Ltd. took a bank loan of 5,00,000 rupees and issued 6,000, 9 percent debentures of 100 rupees each as collateral security. Record by the second method.
Face value of collateral debentures equals 6,000 times 100 rupees equals 6,00,000 rupees.
Debenture Suspense A over c Dr 6,00,000 rupees; To 9 percent Debentures A over c 6,00,000 rupees.
Note on Long-term borrowings: Bank loan 5,00,000 rupees; 9 percent Debentures 6,00,000 rupees less Debenture Suspense 6,00,000 rupees equals nil.
So the answer is Net effect on borrowings is only the loan of 5,00,000 rupees.
